notes.title: Wall Jumping Fix + Skin Select Option for Zolphius Gift Shop
notes.content:
-I fixed a bug, where you would get stuck in a wall when wall jumping into a ceiling
-You can change skins you bought at a Zolphius Gift Shop!!

Enjoy <3
